name: Advertising
description: Money you pay for advertising, including marketing materials.

name: Bad debts
description: Money customers owe you that you don't think you can collect from them.

name: Bank charges
description: Fees your bank charges you such as account fees or certified cheque charges (not interest charges).

name: Commissions and fees
description: Service charges you pay such as realtor commissions, referral fees, or drop ship fees.

name: Cost of Labour - COS
description: Money you pay people to make the goods you sell.

name: Discounts
description: Any discounts you give your customers on your products or services.

name: Discounts given
description: Any discounts you give your customers on your products or services.

name: Disposal Fees
description: Amounts you pay to get rid of items, including garbage disposal and recycling services.

name: Dues and Subscriptions
description: Money you pay regularly for things like trade group memberships or access to magazines or websites.

name: Freight and Delivery
description: Money you pay to deliver products to your customers.

name: Freight and delivery - COS
description: Costs for getting the supplies you use to make your products delivered to you.

name: Insurance
description: Costs for fire, theft, and other insurance for your business (except health insurance).

name: Insurance - Disability
description: Costs for private and government disability insurance for your employees.

name: Insurance - Liability
description: Costs for liability insurance for your business.

name: Interest earned
description: Interest your bank or customers pay you.

name: Interest expense
description: Interest you pay on things like loans, credit cards, and business vehicles.

name: Job Materials
description: Costs for supplies you buy to complete a job or provide a service (not to make products you sell).

name: Legal and professional fees
description: Costs for professional services like legal, financial, accounting, and payroll services.

name: Meals and entertainment
description: The amounts you pay to entertain customers and treat them to meals.

name: Miscellaneous
description: Smaller expeneses that don't fit into other categories.

name: Office expenses
description: Costs for smaller office, kitchen, and bathroom supplies. (Doesn't include software.)

name: Other general and administrative expenses
description: Other expenses, including ones you're not sure where to put. Your accountant can help with these.

name: Other Ordinary Income
description: Money you get from things other than your main business, that aren't a main source of income.

name: Other Portfolio Income
description: Money you get from things like dividends, royalties, and capital gains.

name: Penalties and settlements
description: Fines or penalties you pay that aren't covered by your liability insurance.

name: Prepaid expenses
description: Expenses that you pay for in advance and receive the value of over a longer period of time.

name: Promotional
description: Amounts you pay for promotional items, like branded magnets and other give-aways.

name: Purchases - COS
description: The cost of the materials that go into the products you sell.

name: Refunds-Allowances
description: Money you refund to customers. For example, if they return a product or cancel a service.

name: Rent or lease payments
description: Money you pay to rent or lease things like office space and storage.

name: Repair and maintenance
description: Costs for cleaning and repairing your office space and equipment.

name: Revenus provenant de la vente de produits
fully_qualified_name: Revenus provenant de la vente de produits

name: Sales
description: Money you make from selling products or services.

name: Shipping and delivery expense
description: Costs for getting the supplies you use to make your products delivered to you.

name: Shipping and Delivery Income
description: Money you make from charging customers to ship or deliver products you sell.

name: Stationery and printing
description: Amounts you pay for printing things like company letterhead, invitations, and business cards.

name: Subcontractors
description: Amounts you pay to contractors for things like web design or landscaping (doesn't include wages.)

name: Subcontractors - COS
description: Money you pay to subcontractors to make the goods you sell.

name: Supplies
description: Costs for supplies you buy to complete a job or provide a service (not to make products you sell).

name: Supplies and materials - COS
description: Costs for supplies you use to make the products you sell. For example, disposable gloves.

name: Taxes and Licenses
description: Amounts you pay for licenses, permits, property tax, and business tax (not sales or income tax).

name: Tools
description: Costs for small tools you use to make the products you sell.

name: Travel
description: Business travel costs including transportation, hotels, and tips, but not meals.

name: Travel meals
description: Costs for your meals when you're traveling for business reasons.

name: Uncategorized Income-1
description: Money you make and aren't sure how to categorize. Work with your accountant to sort it out.

name: Undeposited Funds
description: Money you've recieved but haven't taken to the bank yet--like a cheque you haven't cashed.

name: Utilities
description: Utility costs for your business, like phone, gas, electricity, water, and internet.
